- **Story:** As Dana, I want GET endpoints that list a collection and return one stored item by its route parameter or a declared NotFound, so that I can describe the read side of a small service.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given an endpoint GET /items/{id} over the in-memory store of card 132, When its specs run, Then a known id responds with the stored record and status 200, and an unknown id fails with the declared NotFound observed as HTTP 422 with the code (the language's failure mapping), both generated and passing
  2. Given an endpoint GET /items over the store, When its specs run, Then an empty store responds with an empty list (Zero), one stored item responds with a one-element list (One), and several responds with all of them in order (Many)
  3. Given the generated API, When the route parameter is bound, Then the request record carries the id from the path, and the existing POST endpoints and orders.phrase end-to-end test stay green
